/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
# header row at index 3
header = df.iloc[3].tolist()
# rename columns
df.columns = header
# rows from 4 onwards
data = df.iloc[4:].copy()
# clean column names
data.columns = [str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in data.columns]
print(data.columns.tolist())
# filter rows where Transaction ID starts with EXP-
mask = data['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('EXP-')
filtered = data[mask].copy()
# ensure Amount numeric
filtered['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
# drop NaN
filtered = filtered.dropna(subset=['District','Amount (INR)'])
group = filtered.groupby('District')['Amount (INR)'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(group.head(20))
print('Total districts', len(group))
PY"
